titleBox.en: 3 Things That Make My Classes Special

captions.en: So, what makes my classes different?
First, thanks to my corporate background, planning, running, and marketing come easily to me.
And the people I met through work naturally connect me to new opportunities.
Second, I teach in English.

captions.big:
영어로 소통하고 싶은 분
누구나 환영해요
captions.en: Whether you want English kids' barre or just want to practice your English, you're welcome.
Teaching in English has opened up all kinds of opportunities.
Third, it's not just barre.
I've been working out for ten years, and writing for ten years too.

captions.small: 회사를 다니며 다양한 경험을 하다 보니
captions.en: Plus, my years at companies gave me so many experiences that I have plenty of content.
I'm turning that content, piece by piece, into programs built around barre.
Founders, I'm always open to collaborating!
While creating all these opportunities, a thought suddenly hit me:
"If I stop, the money stops."

captions.big:
돈을 벌 수 있는 방법을
고민하기 시작했어요
captions.en: So I started thinking about how to earn even when I'm not working.
It's not urgent yet, but what if I burn out someday?
Remember my recent video about the burned-out wellness instructor?
If I burned out like that and my income suddenly stopped, that would be scary.
Right now, I create and pitch every program myself,

captions.big:
법인으로 더 많은 걸
해보고 싶어요
captions.en: but someday I want to grow it into a company and do much more.
I don't know when the time will come, but I should start preparing now, right?
That's why I've been so busy lately.
My ultimate goal, as I've said before and will keep saying, is to build a wellness community.
I'm not gathering people just yet. I don't think it's time.
As I build my portfolio and expand into new areas,
I plan to invite the people I meet into a wellness community.
You're invited: the Wellness Community.
I'm designing how the community will work and what we'll talk about,
and I'll share more once it takes shape.
To everyone I'll be inviting: you're welcome anytime!
That's a look at my life these days.
From here on, I'll share my many pitches, including the ones that fail,
and show you how I keep building with grit and energy.
Soaming Lab will keep going without burning out. Let's go!
Please cheer me on as I build toward a wellness community.
Bye-bye!
